text: DSH 插件自动更新是一款面向 Web 插件页的更新管理插件：宿主端定时读取所选插件的版本，并通过 DSH 自带的 pluginManager 执行更新；网页面板可选择允许更新的包、设置大版本和预发布策略、立即检查，并查看或清空更新记录。默认只选中注册表安装且版本范围可浮动的插件，更新历史保存在本机。适合希望按白名单维护 DSH 插件的用户。它会查询 npm registry.npmjs.org；不需要额外 API 密钥。

DSH Plugin Auto Update adds a panel to the web plugin page. It checks selected plugins on a schedule and delegates eligible updates to DSH's pluginManager. Choose packages and version policies, run a check, and review update history. It queries registry.npmjs.org and needs no API key.

DSH 插件自动更新的功能「按计划检查并更新」：宿主端按配置的间隔检查启用的插件，查询 npm 最新版本，并把符合选择和版本策略的更新交给 pluginManager。
DSH 插件自动更新的功能「查看更新记录」：插件详情页展示近期更新结果，并可刷新或清空记录；网页面板通过宿主提供的历史接口读取记录。
DSH 插件自动更新会向 registry.npmjs.org 查询候选包的最新版本，查询 URL 包含包名；代码未声明需要 API 密钥。

@chendaleiq/dsh-plugin-auto-update README · 它做什么：- 按计划去 npm 查已安装插件的**最新版本**
- 只更新你勾选的包；本地 `link:` / `file:` 安装、锁定版本、报错的包一律跳过
- 默认**不跨大版本**、**不装预发布**
- 更新走 profile 里运行中的官方 `pluginManager`：profile 写锁、pnpm 执行、bundle 补丁校验、HMR 重载都由它负责；安装失败会把**旧版本装回去**
- 每次更新都记进**更新记录**：插件页里直接看「谁、从哪个版本、到哪个版本、什么时候、成没成」

@chendaleiq/dsh-plugin-auto-update README · 配置：插件页里的面板：插件 → **DSH 插件自动更新** → 详情页底部：

- **启用自动更新** —— 总开关，默认关
- **升级范围** —— 允许跨大版本 / 允许预发布
- **自动更新的插件** —— 列出所有从注册表安装的插件，逐个勾选；「全部可更新的插件」= 通配
- 不能更新的包会置灰并说明原因（本地安装 / 锁定版本 / 存在错误）

改动即时生效，不需要重启。

@chendaleiq/dsh-plugin-auto-update README · 更新记录：详情页底部的第二块就是**更新记录**：按时间倒序列出每次真正发生的动作。

- 一行一条：时间、包名、`旧版本 → 新版本`、结果（已更新 / 更新失败 / 可升级（演练））
- 失败的记录带上回滚说明和原因（鼠标悬停可看完整原因）；更新了宿主半边会标「需重启生效」
- **刷新** 重新读一次；**清空记录** 需要点两次确认（几秒内不点第二次就自动取消）
- 记录只记「和版本有关」的动作：`current`（已经是最新）和 `error`（查不到版本）不写进来，免得记录被刷成流水账
- 同一个包重复出现相同结果（同一个版本反复升级失败、演练反复看到同一个可升级版本）只记一次

数据存在 `~/.dsh/plugin-auto-update-history.json`，最多保留 200 条（`historyLimit` 可改）。面板通过宿主半边提供的
`GET /dsh-plugin-auto-update/history` 读取，删除走同一个地址的 `DELETE`；没有 web server 的部署（headless）里这块会提示接口不可用，记录仍写进日志。
@chendaleiq/dsh-plugin-auto-update README · 语言：跟随 DSH 的语言设置：默认中文，切英文后插件页和面板文案同步变英文。

@chendaleiq/dsh-plugin-auto-update README · 边界（有意为之）：- 只碰「从注册表安装、且依赖写成范围（`^` `~` `*` `latest`）」的包
- 随 DSH 自带的 bundle 不动；不修改你的其它配置
- 网络或插件管理器出错只记录，不中断其它包
- 宿主半边更新后需要重启应用；渲染层由 HMR 直接换掉

@chendaleiq/dsh-plugin-auto-update README · 高级配置：面板没覆盖的字段（`intervalHours` 默认 6 小时、`initialDelayMinutes`、`maxUpdatesPerRun`、`dryRun`、`registry`、`timeoutMs`、`logPath`、`historyPath`、`historyLimit`）写在 profile patch 的 `config` 里，或覆盖 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` 的同一行。改完需要重启。

@chendaleiq/dsh-plugin-auto-update README · 开发：```bash
node test/index.test.mjs    # 宿主半边：检查、更新循环、更新记录的去重与上限
node test/client.test.mjs   # 渲染层：插槽注册、远端信封、置灰原因、记录接口
```

[](LICENSE)

*(Illustration, not a screen recording.)*

@chendaleiq/dsh-plugin-auto-update README · What it does：- Looks up the **newest published version** of installed plugin bundles on npm
- Only touches packages you ticked; local `link:` / `file:` installs, pinned
  versions and bundles with a manager error are skipped
- Never jumps a **major** version and never installs a **prerelease** by default
- Updates go through the profile's running `pluginManager` — profile write lock,
  pnpm run, bundle-patch check and HMR reload stay with it. A failed install
  **reinstalls the previous version**
- Every update lands in an **update history** on the plugin page: which package,
  from which version to which, when, and whether it worked

@chendaleiq/dsh-plugin-auto-update README · Settings: a panel on the plugin's page：- **Version policy** — allow a new major, allow prereleases
- **Plugins that may update** — every registry-installed bundle, each with a
  checkbox; the first row means "all of them"
- **Check now** — runs a cycle immediately instead of waiting for the schedule
- To stop it, switch the bundle off in the plugin page; there is no separate
  switch inside the panel
- A bundle that cannot update is greyed out with its reason (local install,
  pinned, or has an error)

@chendaleiq/dsh-plugin-auto-update README · Update history：The second section at the bottom of the detail page lists what the automatic
updates actually did, newest first.

@chendaleiq/dsh-plugin-auto-update README · Update history：- One row per action: time, package, `old → new`, outcome (updated / failed /
  updatable on a dry run)
- A failed row says it rolled back and carries the reason on hover; a host-half
  update is marked "restart to apply"
- **Refresh** reads the list again; **Clear history** asks for a second click
  (the confirmation expires after a few seconds)
- Only version-relevant actions are stored: `current` (already newest) and
  `error` (the registry could not be read) stay in the log, so the list does not
  fill up with cycles
- A repeated identical outcome for one package (the same failing upgrade, the
  same dry-run preview) is stored once

@chendaleiq/dsh-plugin-auto-update README · Update history：The list lives in `~/.dsh/plugin-auto-update-history.json`, capped at 200 records
(`historyLimit`). The panel reads it through the host half's
`GET /dsh-plugin-auto-update/history` and clears it with `DELETE` on the same
path; a deployment without a web server says the route is unavailable while the
log still records every cycle.

@chendaleiq/dsh-plugin-auto-update README · Language：The copy follows DSH's language setting: Chinese by default, English once the app
is switched.

@chendaleiq/dsh-plugin-auto-update README · Deliberate limits：- Only registry-installed bundles whose dependency is a range (`^`, `~`, `*`,
  `latest`); `link:` / `file:` and exact pins are never touched
- Bundles shipped with the app are never touched; your other configuration stays
  as it is
- Registry or manager failures are logged and never interrupt the other packages
- A host half needs an app restart; a renderer half is swapped by HMR

@chendaleiq/dsh-plugin-auto-update README · Advanced：Fields the panel leaves out (`intervalHours`, six hours by default,
`initialDelayMinutes`, `maxUpdatesPerRun`, `dryRun`, `registry`, `timeoutMs`,
`logPath`, `historyPath`, `historyLimit`) live in this bundle's `config` in the profile patch, or as an
override in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`. Those need a restart.

@chendaleiq/dsh-plugin-auto-update README · Development：```bash
node test/index.test.mjs    # the host half: cycle, history folding and its cap
node test/client.test.mjs   # the renderer half: slot, remote envelope, labels, history route
```
